verdict.rationale: Goodwin is a law firm whose Founders Workbench offers free legal information, document generation and financing calculators. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would consume tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside this product type's axis. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
